settings.heading: The scent
settings.content: Rose, jasmine, peony, and lilac in the opening, settling into warm sandalwood and soft musk. A little nostalgic, decidedly feminine, and entirely her own.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Filled in considered quantities, then sent the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days on an unopened bottle — write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.name: Rose
settings.text: The one everyone recognises, and nobody tires of.

settings.name: Jasmine
settings.text: Opens after dark, like the best conversations.

settings.name: Peony
settings.text: Extravagant for a Tuesday. Wear it anyway.

settings.name: Lilac
settings.text: A garden you walked past once and never forgot.

settings.name: Sandalwood
settings.text: The warmth that stays after the flowers go quiet.

settings.name: Musk
settings.text: Not a scent so much as the memory of one.

settings.story_heading: A small bottle with a long memory
settings.preorder_fulfillment: A preorder, charged today at [price]. Packed carefully by the house and sent the long way when it's ready. Nothing here waits in a warehouse.
